value.signature: fn solve (bound : & BoundProcedure < '_ > , accepted : & crate :: fence :: Search) -> Result < Record , Error >

review.body: { let rung = accepted . selected . as_deref () . ok_or (Error :: Scope) ? ; let (mut result , production) = run (bound , & accepted . evidence , rung , None) ? ; let (checked , mandatory_replay) = run (bound , & result . fence , rung , Some (& result)) ? ; result . replay_work = checked . work ; Ok (Record { revision : "prepared-rational-v1" . into () , solve : result , production , mandatory_replay , }) }
review.item_premise: The prepared receiver retains only frozen public declarations and exact numerical requests, bounds, certificates and actual Work. New coordinate boxes are checked independently; reuse admits no secret, subscriber or publication bytes.
